question: Recently, India's first indigenous Monkeypox RT-PCR test kit is launched. Which private company developed this kit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Transasia Bio-Medicals**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India's first indigenous Monkeypox RT-PCR test kit was developed by **Transasia Bio-Medicals**.
 
• The kit is designed to detect the Monkeypox virus through **real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR)**, ensuring high accuracy in diagnosis.
 
• Transasia Bio-Medicals is a leading Indian company in the field of **in-vitro diagnostic (IVD) solutions**, known for its innovation and quality.
 
• This development aligns with India's effort to strengthen its healthcare infrastructure and address emerging infectious diseases like Monkeypox.
 
• Monkeypox is a zoonotic disease caused by the **Monkeypox virus**, a member of the Orthopoxvirus genus in the Poxviridae family.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Monkeypox Virus:**

 
 
• The Monkeypox virus is an Orthopoxvirus, similar to the virus that causes smallpox.
 
• The disease is characterized by fever, rash, and swollen lymph nodes, with occasional severe complications.
 
• Human cases of Monkeypox were first identified in 1970 in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
 
 
 
• **RT-PCR Technology:**
 
 
• RT-PCR stands for Real-Time Polymerase Chain Reaction, a molecular technique used for detecting and quantifying nucleic acids.
 
• It is highly sensitive and specific, making it ideal for diagnosing infectious diseases.
 
• RT-PCR has been widely used during the COVID-19 pandemic and is now adapted for Monkeypox detection.
 
 
 
• **Global Monkeypox Outbreak:**
 
 
• In 2022, Monkeypox cases were reported in non-endemic regions, leading to a global health alert.
 
• The World Health Organization (WHO) declared Monkeypox a public health emergency of international concern.
 
• Efforts are underway worldwide to improve diagnostic tools and vaccines for Monkeypox.
 
 
 
• **Transasia Bio-Medicals:**
 
 
• Founded in 1979, Transasia Bio-Medicals is one of India's largest IVD companies.
 
• It offers diagnostic solutions in areas such as hematology, biochemistry, immunology, and microbiology.
 
• The company has a presence in over 130 countries and continues to invest in innovation to address healthcare challenges.
